image_description: A close-up portrait of a Roseate Spoonbill (Platalea ajaja). The image focuses on the head, neck, and upper chest. The bird features a distinctive long, flat, greyish bill with a spatulate tip. The plumage is a mix of white on the neck and vibrant pink on the shoulders/back. There is a patch of greenish-grey skin around the eye and base of the bill. The background is a soft-focus green, suggesting foliage.
